title: crm.pipeline.deal.stage_changed
description: A deal moved stage under deal's transition rule. `from` and `to` are the stages; the rest is the deal's state after the move. `closed_at` is set when `to` is closed_won or closed_lost (a closed deal moves nowhere afterwards) and null otherwise.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I3): services/deal/app/services.py:move_stage does not emit name, value_minor, currency, owner_id, probability, closed_at yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
